usage_notes: The term is not inherently derogatory or offensive, and is simply the Singaporean Hokkien term for 'Indian'. However, nowadays, increasingly many people find this term extremely offensive, and it is considered even more derogatory in Malaysia. This word can still be heard in Singaporean Hokkien, especially among Pioneer Generation and Merdeka Generation speakers, who use it in an entirely non-offensive sense (as it was in the past). However, great care must be taken; due to the modern connotations of the word, it would be better to avoid using this term in Singlish.
